plugins.name: nitrosend
plugins.description: Remote Nitrosend MCP plugin for Claude. Connect with OAuth to compose newsletters, build flows, manage contacts, and send campaigns.

skills.name: analytics
skills.description: Inspect Nitrosend account, campaign, flow, or message performance and turn live metrics into bounded recommendations. Use when: "email analytics", "campaign performance", "how are my emails doing", "email insights", "check my stats", "open rate", or "deliverability report".
skills.description_zh: 查询 Nitrosend 账号、营销活动、自动化流程或消息的实时表现，分析打开率、投递和统计，并给出限定于证据的建议。

skills.name: build-flow
skills.description: Build email/SMS automation flows with triggers, steps, waits, splits, and webhooks. Covers welcome series, cart abandonment, post-purchase, win-back, browse abandonment, and custom event-driven flows. Use when: "automation flow", "welcome series", "drip campaign", "cart abandonment flow", "win-back flow", "build flow", or "email sequence".
skills.description_zh: 搭建 Nitrosend 邮件或短信自动化，配置触发、步骤、等待、分支及 webhook，覆盖欢迎、弃购、购买后、召回、浏览放弃和自定义事件流程。

skills.name: compose-email
skills.description: Create or edit email templates with Nitrosend's section-based designer. Guides through layout, content, and brand styling. Supports preview and test sends. Use when: "compose email", "design template", "create email", "email template", "edit template", or "update email design".
skills.description_zh: 用 Nitrosend 分区设计器创建编辑邮件模板，安排布局、内容和品牌样式，支持预览及测试发送。

skills.name: email-marketing-bible
skills.description: Apply durable email-marketing principles without treating static benchmarks, laws, vendor features, or prices as current facts. Use for strategy, flows, deliverability, copy, segmentation, measurement, and platform evaluation.
skills.description_zh: 应用长期有效的邮件营销原则指导策略、自动化、投递、文案、分群、衡量和平台评估；原说明要求不把静态基准、法律、功能或价格当成当前事实。

skills.name: import-contacts
skills.description: Import contacts into Nitrosend from inline records or CSV. Handles email opt-in, SMS TCPA compliance, list assignment, and tagging. Use when: "import contacts", "add subscribers", "upload contacts", "add to list", "bulk add contacts", or "import CSV".
skills.description_zh: 从内联记录或 CSV 导入 Nitrosend 联系人，处理邮件订阅同意、短信 TCPA 合规、名单分配和标签。

skills.name: send-campaign
skills.description: End-to-end campaign workflow: create, design, target audience, preview, test, approve, and send or schedule an email or SMS campaign. Use when: "send campaign", "email blast", "newsletter", "send to my list", "broadcast email", or "schedule campaign".
skills.description_zh: 完整组织 Nitrosend 邮件或短信活动，依次创建、设计、选受众、预览、测试和批准，再发送或定时安排。

skills.name: send-transactional
skills.description: Send transactional emails or SMS for app-triggered communications: receipts, password resets, OTPs, order confirmations, shipping notifications, system alerts. Single recipient, immediate delivery, no campaign or approval needed. Use when: "transactional email", "receipt email", "password reset email", "send notification email", "order confirmation", "OTP email", or "system email".
skills.description_zh: 发送应用触发的单收件人事务邮件或短信，如收据、密码重置、OTP、订单确认、物流通知及系统提醒；原说明将其设为即时交付且无需营销活动审批的流程。

skills.name: setup
skills.description: Guided Nitrosend onboarding. Walks through remote MCP connection, Brand Kit identity setup, brand-subdomain preparation or customer-domain verification, and sender defaults. Also offers to configure proactive analytics (daily/weekly/monthly reports). Use when: "set up nitrosend", "configure email", "onboard", "get started with nitrosend", or when nitro_get_status shows incomplete onboarding.
skills.description_zh: 引导 Nitrosend 初始配置，包括远程 MCP、Brand Kit、品牌子域或客户域验证和默认发件人，并可配置每日、每周或每月主动分析报告。
